patterns: APPSC asks single-fact scheme/body items: who launched the livestock credit guarantee scheme (Dept of AH&D, not NABARD/RBI), MIDH start year 2014-15.
AP-specific GI/variety items (Banganapalle GI 2017) and AP ranks (eggs, aquaculture, oil palm) are the AP tilt.
Other PSCs ask leading state/country facts (mulberry - Karnataka, banana top fruit, Alphonso export mango, China largest silk/fish producer).
Revolutions/colour matching (Blue = fish) recurs as an easy match.
App MCQs are heavier on multi-statement items with Economic Survey 2025-26 numbers than the PYQs show.
